name: Romance Protocol
summary:
You're the only human in a school full of monsters.

But you're not a threat… at least not in the way they think. Armed with a peculiar device, you fire compliments, flowers, and gifts instead of bullets.

The monsters, unable to handle so much affection, flee at the sight of you. If you manage to affect them enough, their hearts collapse… and they leave their essence behind for you to collect.

However, it's not all that easy. The Headmaster, an imposing creature immune to your charms, will relentlessly pursue you to banish you from his world.

Face rejection, spread love by force, and survive this chaotic and adorable school hell.
